title: Enterprise Connectivity: on-demand termination fee
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following on-demand termination fee for each named contract tier. Fee for terminating an on-demand holding, excluding accrued usage and commitment liability; USD decimal.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | on-demand termination fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | on-demand termination fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | on-demand termination fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | on-demand termination fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | on-demand termination fee | 0 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | on-demand termination fee | 0 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the on-demand termination fee is 0.
